subject: CVE-2025-13502
object: A flaw was found in WebKitGTK and WPE WebKit. This vulnerability allows an out-of-bounds read and integer underflow, leading to a UIProcess crash (DoS) via a crafted payload to the GLib remote inspector server.
object_canonical: a flaw was found in webkitgtk and wpe webkit. this vulnerability allows an out-of-bounds read and integer underflow, leading to a uiprocess crash (dos) via a crafted payload to the glib remote inspector server.
